reason: My WhatsApp group already tells me who is good for this kind of work -- a neighbour vouches and that is enough for me. I do not open some new app to book someone for a repair or a tuition class, Tamil or not.
objection: Verification on the app is just a badge from a company I don't know -- it is not the same as my neighbour saying 'yes, this person did my work well and didn't cheat me.' Nothing here tells me anyone around me actually uses this.
would_change_my_mind: If two or three people in my own apartment WhatsApp group had actually booked someone through it and said it worked out well, I would try it.
